groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access

rows.label: Howl of the Kubrow
rows.note: after the Venus to Mercury Junction; steal the Incubator Segment on Unda, find an egg on E Prime, finish Defense on Gaia

conditions: The first den in the quest drops an egg 100% of the time and the first hatch takes 1 minute, but it is still a random breed.
The blueprint is a reusable 50,000-credit Market purchase. Every incubation consumes a core, win or lose.
bonuses: The Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment halves incubation to 24h: Tenno Lab research, MR 5 to craft, 100,000 cr, 1 Argon Crystal, 1 Power Core, 1,200 Oxium.

rows.label: Sunika Kubrow
rows.note: the wiki publishes no breed odds
rows.alt: use two Sunika Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Anything but a Sunika means another egg and core. You can have a Kubrow equipped while one incubates.
Imprints do not replace the egg or core. Use two Sunika imprints, not one plus another breed, which is roughly a coin flip.
Mature the pup in the Incubator and rank it to 30 for the Mastery. Its Beast Claws give no Mastery.
bonuses: Imprints are tradeable. Each Kubrow can be imprinted twice at 1.5 hours per imprint, during which it is unusable, and you cannot cancel one.

disclosures.title: imprint templates
disclosures.body: Genetic Code Templates build from a reusable 50,000-credit blueprint, then 10,000 cr, 700 Nano Spores, 300 Circuits and 1 Control Module, 6h. Kubrow and Kavat imprints are not interchangeable. Size is never stored in imprints.
